ph-palawan-north-road.story: Repeated coastal bends, headlands and frequent viewpoint stops. It also links naturally to Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park.
ph-palawan-north-road.legalNote: Verify ferries, typhoon effects, road condition and local access. Specific flag: road works; rain; traffic.
